notes.title: MagiScapes Third Public Test Update Announcement – 2025.09.02
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers!
Over the past few days of exploration, we’ve continued gathering your feedback and have rolled out another round of updates and optimizations. Below are the details of this update:
[hr][/hr]New Content & Adjustments
New Area & Pathways
A brand-new underground passage has appeared, leading directly to the “Red Dragon’s” lair. We’ve also adjusted the Red Dragon’s location.
(Note: This change will only take effect in a newly created save file!)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/366d4e05760224055ae1f605c1dd0fe21c5226d1.gif"]

AI Quest Generation System Upgrade
Thanks to improvements in our technical framework, other AI-NPCs in town are now also able to issue AI-generated quests! We hope you enjoy even more diverse adventures.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/c9bf291f5ad073d1d8a0ac361c94a03ed5ff4eba.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]System Optimizations
Quest Generation Logic
We’ve removed the special-case logic previously used for certain AI quests, making the system run more smoothly and efficiently.

Unified Quest Triggering
From now on, all NPC-issued AI quests will unlock after you interact with them and increase your relationship level. The flow should feel more natural and coherent.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Data Error Fix
Resolved a data error that could occur during “Harvesting” interactions.

Quest Interface Optimization
Fixed an issue where using the “Tab” key to open the quest interface could cause display or functionality errors.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you all for your continued support and feedback! We hope this update brings you a smoother and more enjoyable adventure. If you encounter issues not listed above, please feel free to join our community and share them with us!

— MagiScapes Dev Team

notes.title: Magi Scapes – 08.29 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Hero-sama:
Here’s a summary of what we’ve fixed and improved in this update.
[hr][/hr]Quest System
Fixed dialogue issues in the Golden Thread and Ignacia quests

Resolved a problem where submitting a quest could cause the game to freeze

Improved the way quest objectives are tracked and displayed
NPC Behavior
Raiders will no longer attack characters who are already down

Quests now progress correctly when teammates defeat monsters

Improved NPC movement and teleportation logic
Map & Interface
Fixed crashes that sometimes occurred when opening the minimap

Corrected icon errors on the minimap

Fixed abnormal responses when pressing certain UI buttons
Building System
Improved placement detection for items and structures

Fixed crops shifting position after reaching maturity
Performance
Fixed severe lag caused by camp area calculations; movement no longer causes frame drops

Significantly improved item rendering and overall map performance
AI Character Generation
Added a cancel button to stop character generation at any time

Optimized the generation process to reduce failure rates
Game Systems
The game now auto-saves at key moments

Added clear notifications when saving progress

Improved item stacking safety

Recipe adjustments:

Temporarily removed the White Ruins Floor recipe

Corrected the mashed potato recipe and rebalanced its nutrition values
Visuals
Improved ghost visuals for fallen NPCs, with different effects for recruitable NPCs and camp NPCs

Enhanced overall lighting and visual quality

NPCs now move more smoothly through narrow passages
Player Experience
Improved the clarity of error messages

Enhanced the presentation of visual effects

Greatly reduced the likelihood of crashes
[hr][/hr]
Thank you again for all your feedback and support. We will continue working hard to bring you the best possible experience.

If you encounter issues not listed here, please join our community and let us know.

— Magi Scapes Develope Team

notes.title: Ready for the New Version of Magi Scapes? Public Test Starts on August 27th!
notes.notes:
Greeting, Hero-Sama! Morning, noon, or night—whenever you’re reading this, the land of Oz is calling you back!

We’re kicking off a brand-new public test on August 27th at 05:00(UTC+0)/August 26th at 22:00(Pacific Time)!  

The test will run for two whole weeks, so grab your gear (and your curiosity) and come hang out in the game again~

It’s been half a year since the last test, and we’ve been super busy during that time. Tons of optimizations, bug fixes, polish, and yes… some highly requested features are finally here.



The highlight this time? Your AI partners just got way smarter! They’ll listen more closely, adventure more naturally, and even let you know what they need from you!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/fbfaa04e86498917bdc5c35ba7d1f803b4c30345.png"]

Oh, and did we mention… Oz is now a real continent!


With a borderless, procedurally generated map, you and your unique AI partners can set off on a brand-new adventure that’s truly your own.


[hr][/hr]What’s New This RoundCharacters & NPCs
Snow Willow has brand-new art + expressions


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/55508040ffaabeb9e73b254bc0d8d69ab62d5aa8.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/0a34a0d77bb2e8da364e3bbc58db6447ae0ebc49.png"][/carousel][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/c24d9acc62143c44a5eae623bf45dd91f7cceb9a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/c325e30f59d68fbef4e07ac118b34ab463be0a17.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/6e45594622cac2d99c881117b83c1c8282d580fd.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/55198681acfe372f941e0d8abd6d3c918615a0fd.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/efb197953a13b5a7227feeb0381fd239fc4cf581.jpg"][/carousel]
NPCs can now craft specific items on request

NPC daily life feels more natural

Fixed follower NPCs getting stuck in buildings after death
Combat
Adjusted monster stats & behaviors

Nerfed the overpowered Thorn Mage (finally )

Improved Giant Rats + Mummy Warrior battles

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/7f26e96733e1e3433c2c775f39b3fa9f5240d980.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/9e9b25cc70c9616f6e6c92ae4db8e8f08aabc675.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/9c9f010e7b538cfc0eaf542d8d1c1b0a9dbb0fbe.gif"]

Ice Slimes & Yetis now slow you down—watch out!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/1bdc3822d1b7c754fcd70df2abac4e0b2cad99cc.gif"]
Visuals & Effects
Cleaner, shinier effects everywhere

Lighting adjustments = better atmosphere

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/35fe8e291f77eaa8cc2e159b15d3b91881373de3.png"]

Tons of texture/material fixes for smoother looks
Music & Sound
Towns now have their own BGM 

Music changes depending on biome

Churches got new sound logic
Bug Fixes & Optimizations
Fixed crashes on reloading after forced quits

No more weird random names

Quest completion UI looks better

Camera fixes for Raider missions

Fixed crashes when submitting quests

No more duplicate AI quests

Item placement on water fixed

Better terrain handling for characters

Water physics, ladders, particles—smoothed out

Major Update

Greatly improved map loading efficiency
[hr][/hr]
That sums up our efforts over the past six months!
Even as you read this announcement, development on the next version is already underway. In the meantime, we’ll be reaching out and engaging with you more frequently.

So, if you have any questions about Maggie’s Garden, feel free to leave a comment below or click the button to join our community!
We look forward to building this world together with you!

notes.title: Magi Scapes Demo Update Announcement 2025.7.31
notes.notes:
Update Details – July 31, 2025[hr][/hr]I. New Features1. NPC Module
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/230bed5f1e2a84ca7d40bba09e460b26fc7c97af.png"]

Added AI-NPC attribute generation and logic: you can now recruit NPCs with different professions and attributes.

Added AI-NPC ability generation and logic: different NPCs will use various abilities based on their life skills.

Added AI-NPC personality generation and parameters: NPCs with different personalities will exhibit distinct combat and life behaviors.
2. Quest Module
Added AI-generated NPC quest system: quests are now dynamically generated based on character backstories, including related NPCs, quest items, and tools.

Added new weapon types: Hammer, Dagger, and Staff.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/06ec76d80764aa6d843ae427768b5cda6c61a9ca.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/da30c00a1ac6e70937ea5860c731bfaaf0c7ce35.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/f5dc1f350c66b285569172f46ea03218ced6b8e1.gif"]

Added 10 new monster types.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/1bdc3822d1b7c754fcd70df2abac4e0b2cad99cc.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/7f26e96733e1e3433c2c775f39b3fa9f5240d980.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/9c9f010e7b538cfc0eaf542d8d1c1b0a9dbb0fbe.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/9e9b25cc70c9616f6e6c92ae4db8e8f08aabc675.gif"]
4. Environment Module
Introduced a dynamic lighting system: the in-game lighting now changes with the day-night cycle.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/6b22987d8f750fe1112be21f953aa1857cc14670.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/35fe8e291f77eaa8cc2e159b15d3b91881373de3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/dd05e6e7ad83b5b77fd9401f2d3bd8ed5b0435ef.png"]
[hr][/hr]II. Optimizations
Optimized most UI layouts and visual aesthetics.

Improved AI-NPC generation quality: now produces higher-quality character portraits and models.

Enhanced AI-NPC behavior display logic: NPCs now show bubble prompts when performing actions.

Improved AI-NPC backstory generation: dialogues and narrative texts are now more coherent and immersive.

Refined music and sound effects: added environmental ambiance and monster sounds.

Enhanced visual effects for water, lava, and other environmental elements.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/552d20614b016c9f72784112325c562c1cca4ad4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/9904583156c43111efe403dc3fcba3c92308094d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/881ae4fdab53ec0d5ce592bba4d07d7edcb018d5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/230bed5f1e2a84ca7d40bba09e460b26fc7c97af.png"]

notes.title: Magi Scapes Demo Minor Update Announcement 2025.2.7
notes.notes:
Happy Chinese New Year! After the Spring Festival holiday, we have released our first small update with the following changes: 

Bug Fixes


[olist]
 Fixed an issue where the Red Dragon would not properly spawn during quests.
 Fixed an issue where the Spanish localization was not included in the game package.
 Fixed an issue where vegetation could be placed at the water’s edge in plains.
[/olist]

Feature Updates


[olist]
 Added a Resurrection Elixir as a reward for the Raider mission. 
 Simplified camp missions. 
 Introduced an automatic save backup feature, allowing up to three daily save backups. 
 Added additional error reporting details. 
 Improved the fishing success indicator—when a fish bites, the marker will now tremble once. 
[/olist]
